subject: AWS Marketplace private offer — approval brokerage & evidence split
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Amrita Singh <amrita@medicore.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: AWS PO — suggested term, pricing, and buyer approvals

Hi Amrita,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great context on the inferencing patterns for your image triage workload. Based on the usage profile you shared, we can prepare an AWS Marketplace private offer with the following starter proposal: 

- Term: 12 months (preferred by your finance lead)
- Pricing: pay-as-you-go blended with a small committed monthly baseline to qualify for co-sell crediting (starter: $8k/mo committed + usage overage)
- Activation window: private offer ready within 5 business days after approval (DocuSign stage)

Two coordination items I need from you to move to a private-offer draft:
1) Who will be the primary approver on your side (name + email + role)? Procurement? CFO?
2) Evidence pack — do you need SOC2/ISO artifacts in the offer or will an evidence link and an attestation suffice for procurement?

I attached our scoping PDF and a baseline evidence checklist so you can forward to ProcureOps. If it helps, Ben can handle the marketplace-side activation and Vanessa can own any special entitlement notes for co-sell.

Next steps: if you confirm approver + evidence preference, I’ll draft the private offer and circulate a plan for signatures.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MediCore-AWS-PO-ML-Scoping.pdf (application/pdf), evidence-pack-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Amrita Singh <amrita@medicore.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS PO — suggested term, pricing, and buyer approvals

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the proposal — the 12-month term aligns with what procurement prefers. Quick answers: 
- Primary approver: Priya Shah, Head of Procurement (priyaa.shah@healthco.com) — Priya owns PO signoff for third-party cloud contracts.
- Evidence: procurement wants SOC2 plus an attestation URL; they rarely accept only an attestation but will accept a link to hosted artifacts + contact to request more detailed evidence.

I’ll loop Priya in separately but wanted to confirm we’re aligned on term and baseline pricing.

Best,
Amrita
VP Product, MediCore Health
amrita@medicore.ai

Ben — can you take the marketplace activation (config private offer + billing mapping)? If we set the baseline commit at $8k/mo and tag for co-sell, what lead time are we looking at for AWS activation from our side? Any special fields procurement usually asks for in the PO metadata?

Vanessa — can you draft a short attestation statement and a one-paragraph co-sell entitlements note we can include with the offer (so procurement and legal see how co-sell crediting will work)?

Thanks — Rachel

Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 09:07:00 -0700

Rachel / Vanessa —

I can take the marketplace activation. Quick notes: 
- AWS activation (private offer metadata + billing tag) typically takes 3-4 business days once we have approver email and legal name to populate the contract.
- Procurement frequently asks for: bill-to legal entity, PO contact email, contract term start date, and whether the offer needs to be restricted to a specific AWS account ID.
- For co-sell crediting, we should include the Partner ID and attach the co-sell entitlements doc (one-pager).

I’ll prepare the marketplace-side draft and push to our internal activation queue after Priya confirms.

Ben
Senior Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Hi all —

Attached the attestation language and the co-sell entitlements blurb. Short summary: 
- Attestation: "Redwood Inference maintains SOC2 Type II controls; customers may request read-only evidence via our secure portal; we will provide an evidence link in the private offer."
- Co-sell entitlements: 1) Redwood will register the deal for co-sell; 2) co-sell crediting applies to committed baseline spend; 3) seller to provide activation evidence within 7 days of go-live.

Amrita — please confirm that the attestation and the entitlement language are acceptable to Priya. If procurement requires the SOC2 artifact attached directly to the offer, let me know and I’ll escalate to SecurityOps to bundle a redacted artifact.

Thanks,
